The tool says "destination must be local to the current directory and cannot be a path. If destination is not an existing directory like when renaming something, destination is the new file name." So if we pass 'temp', it will treat it as a directory and move the file into that directory. That seems correct.

Thus steps: mkdir temp, then mv final_report.pdf temp.
